decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from 06th September 2016 being the date of the granting of planning permission 000/D24/P1.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL 01,02, 03, 04,05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 010, 011, 12A, 13A, 14A received 17/11/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise specified on approved plans. All materials shall be used in accordance with the approved details
description: Variation of condition 2 of planning permission 00083/D24/P1 dated 6/9/2016 to make changes to approved plans to increase height of extension for erection of single storey front extension to existing industrial units.
